page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top right. No margin notes. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: xit. Hæc enim idololatriæ lerna, Diabolicæ superstitionis pestem fovet, quâ viduæ in ardentem mariti rogum insilire suadetur, quâque homines Diabolo gratificari volentes impulsi, rotis currus, quo abominabilis illorum Vcjovis vehitur, se proterendos & examinandos obijciunt; circumfusa plebe, illorum membra inter se dividente; ut qui propter Idolo devotam vitam, horum corporum sanctimoniâ se sanctificari posse, perfuasum habeant. Summum quidem in ipsis malorum est, verum Deum non cognovisse, & ad Idolorum cultum, indeque natas superstitiones prorepere: sed quæ hinc promanat in eorum animos desperatio, & misera in rebus adversis trepidatio, humanos sensus magis ferit, & illorum ab omni felicitate abalienationem magis reddit evidentem. Ad hujus autem considerationem priusquam procedamus; confiteamur necesse est, magnam ipsis conquerendi causam esse, quod orbis Christianus, hactenus tam parum libertati illorum studuerit, quos infructuosâ misericordiâ, verbis magis quam animo, sub ferreo Diaboli jugo enecari doluit. Quod illos qui Deum rerum omnium creatorem, unâ cum suâ potentiâ, sapientiâ & bonitate, non tantum

page.notes: Printed "Vcjovis" as it stands; the Latin form may be "Vejovis" [?]. The signature "N 5" is read from a worn mark and is doubtful. Hyphenated line-end "re-rum" was joined as "rerum". The text is printed in long s throughout, here given as plain s. The paragraph break before "Ad hujus" was not clear from the scan, so the running text was taken as one paragraph.
